text:
ITEM 1 | Sliced orange-colored carrot-like rounds and wedges, glossy with slight sheen, firm, some pieces with pale center rings, cut into roughly 2-3 cm thick half-moons and chunky wedges, clustered on the left side of the plate, moist surface with light caramelized edges | 150
ITEM 2 | Dark green leafy greens, wilted spinach-like leaves with glossy moist surface, mixed with small pale grains and scattered red pepper pieces, spread across the lower right and center of the plate, leaves about 5-10 cm long, partially folded | 110
ITEM 3 | Browned cubed meat pieces, roughly 1.5-2.5 cm chunks with darker brown seared edges and pinkish-brown interior, slightly glossy, mixed among green leaves and grains in the upper center of the plate | 95
ITEM 4 | Cooked pale grains, small off-white to tan kernels scattered among greens and meat, dry-looking, separate, loosely distributed across the center of the plate | 25
ITEM 5 | Diced red pepper pieces, bright red with glossy skin, roughly 0.5-1 cm pieces, scattered among the greens and near the meat in the center and lower right | 12
